generate.title: Text-to-Image Generation
generate.desc: Generate brand new high quality images from textual prompt descriptions using Google Gemini Imagen 3.
generate.promptParam: prompt (string, required) : Detailed description of the image to generate (max 2,000 chars)
generate.sessionParam: session_id (string, optional) : Session ID to group conversation history
generate.modelParam: model (string, optional) : Gemini AI model selection (3.7-flash, 3.5-flash-lite, 3.1-pro, extended-thinking)

edit.title: Image-to-Image Editing
edit.desc: Edit or modify specific parts of existing images based on natural language instructions.
edit.promptParam: prompt (string, required) : Modification directives or regional editing instructions
edit.imageParam: image (string, required) : Input image in Base64 Data URL or public image URL
edit.aspectRatioParam: aspect_ratio (string, optional) : Target aspect ratio for the edited output
edit.modelParam: model (string, optional) : Gemini AI model selection

sessions.title: Sessions CRUD & Message History
sessions.desc: All conversation sessions and message streams are stored locally in the SQLite database.
sessions.listDesc: GET /api/sessions : Retrieve list of all user conversation sessions.
sessions.createDesc: POST /api/sessions : Create a new session with type 'generate' or 'edit'.
sessions.detailDesc: GET /api/sessions/:id : Retrieve full session details and all messages.
sessions.deleteDesc: DELETE /api/sessions/:id : Permanently delete a session and all its messages.

auth.title: API Key Authentication & Integrations
auth.desc: Provide Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> header to authenticate integration requests from n8n, Antigravity, OpenCode, or curl.

responses.title: Response Format & Error Codes
responses.successDesc: 200 OK: Returns { ok: true, images: [{ file, url, width, height }] }
responses.error400: 400 Bad Request: Invalid or missing prompt/image parameters or payload exceeded limits
responses.error401: 401 Unauthorized: Missing or revoked API Key
responses.error403: 403 Quota Exceeded: Daily request quota limit reached for your account
responses.error500: 500 Internal Error: Server or browser automation failure
